sentences.text:
...Petitioners
 Versus
State Of Maharashtra Thr Secretary And Ors.

... Respondents
 ---------
 Mr. T. S. Ingale, for Petitioners.

Mrs. M. S. Bane, Agp for Respondent Nos.1 to 3.
 ---------
 Coram : R.D. Dhanuka &
 Gauri Godse, Jj.

Dated : 15th March, 2023 P.C. :
.

A short grievance of the Petitioners is that no Notification was served in respect of the writ property either on the father of the Petitioners (original owner) or on the Petitioners before making an Award in the year 1997.
It is the case of Petitioners that the Award was passed only when the land in question was allotted to a third party.
The Respondent Nos.4 & 5 are those allottees according to the Petitioners.
2. Learned AGP waives service on behalf of Respondent Nos.1 to 3.
Issue notice to Respondent Nos.4 and 5, returnable 23 WP-1900-2023.doc on 24th April, 2023.
Humdast is permitted.
In addition to the Court notice, the Petitioners are also permitted to serve Respondent Nos.4 & 5 by private notice, by all permissible modes of services available in law.
3. Respondent Nos.1 to 3 to file an affidavit in reply within three weeks from today and to produce original files relating to acquisition in question.

Respondent Nos.4 & 5 are also directed to file an affidavit in reply within two weeks from the date of service of the papers and proceedings upon the Shamgonda Dada Patil Since Dec Annaso ... vs State Of Maharashtra Thr Secretary And ... on 15 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89130116/

sentences.text: Respondents with a copy to be served upon the Petitioners' advocate simultaneously.

An affidavit in reply that would be filed Respondent Nos. 1 and 3 shall disclose as to when notices were issued and served under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 upon the father of the Petitioners' Mr.
Shamgonda Dada Patil and the proof showing the acknowledgment of service of the notice.

Respondent Nos.1 & 3 shall also produce proof as to whether the notice under Section 12(2) of The Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was served for the purpose of payment of compensation and if served,
on whom.
4.
Learned counsel for the Petitioners tenders a copy of the communication dated 28.09.2022 and mutation entry dated 23 WP-1900-2023.doc 31.01.2023.

Learned counsel for the Petitioners seeks leave to challenge the said communication and the mutation entry and to add additional averments,
grounds and prayer in the petition.
Leave to amend the petition is granted.
Amendment shall be carried out within one week from today.
Copy supplied to the Respondent Nos.1 & 3 also shall be amended within one week thereafter.

Amended copy of the petition shall be supplied in the Office,
to enable the Office to effect service upon Respondent Nos.4 & 5 in advance.
5. Respondent Nos.1 to 3 are directed not to dis-possess the Petitioners from writ property till next date.

(GAURI GODSE, J.) (R.D. DHANUKA, J.)
